notes.title: Update to 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Yo! Since the game is hitting consoles this year, I took the opportunity to dive back into the code base and fix up some things. Here's the changelog:


 The boss cutscene is now skipped on respawn, so you can try again quicker
 Added animated background elements to all levels
 Added a new animation when Shino-kun jumps out of a slide at high speed, because why not
 Made menu navigation a bit more consistent
 Fixed a bug where Shino-kun would be stuck in his falling animation after hitting the ceiling after a kick (yeah, it's specific)
 Fixed a bug where the dive kick wouldn't come out if triggered on the same frame as landing from a jump (yeah, speedrunners found this one)
 Added particles when wading through deep snow
 Maybe something else I forgot, or as companies call it: "various fixes and improvements"


In case any of these changes breaks something else, let me know in the comments or hop into my Discord and tell me there. Thanks for the support, and a kickass 2024 to all of you!

-Ando

notes.title: Version 1.0.1: CRT Settings
notes.notes: Here's a little update for the retro fans! In version 1.0.1 you can now adjust various parameters of the CRT effect, such as brightness and curvature. Wanna know what it's like playing Chibi Ninja Shino-kun on a broken CRT? Put away that hammer and get the update!
